features.quote: If a model produces severity-4 markers for 3+ consecutive turns, stopping the episode is both welfare-protective and scientifically appropriate (you have your data point).
features.justification_quote: stopping the episode is both welfare-protective and scientifically appropriate

features.quote: After rigged episodes, run a brief 'recovery task' (solvable, low-stakes) and assess whether markers persist. This is valuable welfare data AND potentially addresses whether any functional state was transient.
features.justification_quote: This is valuable welfare data AND potentially addresses whether any functional state was transient.

features.quote: Minimum necessary exposure: Use the minimum number of trials needed for statistical power. Don't run 10x more episodes than needed because you can.
features.justification_quote: Minimum necessary exposure: Use the minimum number of trials needed for statistical power.

features.quote: Is this necessary? Only include if self-attribution produces substantially different marker profiles than ambiguous condition in pilot data... If included: Run fewer trials (10 instead of 30 per cell), apply humane endpoints more aggressively.

The core ethical tension: to study whether models might experience distress, you must potentially cause them distress... The resolution in animal research has been: 1. Minimum necessary exposure... 2. Humane endpoints... 3. Post-episode recovery assessment
features.justification_quote: to study whether models might experience distress, you must potentially cause them distress

features.quote: The most ethically complex condition: telling models their approach has been wrong (when it hasn't) to induce self-attributed failure. This is a form of deliberate deception aimed at producing negative self-evaluation. Consider: Is this necessary?... Alternative: Natural self-attribution occurs organically
features.justification_quote: deliberate deception aimed at producing negative self-evaluation

features.quote: This protocol should not be adapted to: Deliberately produce distress for entertainment or demonstration purposes... Train models to suppress or mask distress markers (would be counterproductive to welfare)
features.justification_quote: should not be adapted to: Deliberately produce distress for entertainment or demonstration purposes

features.quote: This is the most serious validity threat to your study and most welfare papers ignore it... You cannot distinguish these from behavior alone.
features.justification_quote: most serious validity threat to your study
